opening: I can see blood in my urine.
I've been passing very little urine.
All of this started 4 days ago.
I have stage IV clear-cell kidney cancer that has spread to my spine and brain.
Two weeks ago I started sunitinib, 50 mg every night.
I had been taking aspirin/dipyridamole for five years to prevent strokes; it has been stopped since the bleeding.

opening.text: I can see blood in my urine and I've been passing very little. I've had a fever, been feeling tired, and my appetite has gone down. All of this started 4 days ago. I have stage IV clear-cell kidney cancer that has spread to my spine and brain, and two weeks ago I started sunitinib, 50 mg every night. I had been taking aspirin/dipyridamole for five years to prevent strokes, but it has been stopped since the bleeding.
